subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should proactive fallback readiness be a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command, or should ordered fallback reporting be folded into the broader `models status --probe --all` direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63145?
rationale: Both commands are useful and source-reproducible, but they overlap in live provider execution and could become competing diagnostic sources unless maintainers choose one canonical contract.

options.title: Unify probe infrastructure
options.body: Implement one canonical live model probe and support both per-model health and ordered fallback reporting without duplicating runtime logic.

options.title: Dedicated fallback command
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped fallback-order command with agent overrides and explicit first/all modes, while keeping general model health separate.

options.title: Keep current diagnostics
options.body: Decline proactive fallback testing and retain provider-auth probes plus reactive runtime failover only.

recommendation.title: Unify probe infrastructure
recommendation.body: Implement one canonical live model probe and support both per-model health and ordered fallback reporting without duplicating runtime logic.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the existing item-specific product review and has the strongest recent merged history across fallback policy and model diagnostics.
